claim_scope: Qwen3.5-0.8B, RTX 4060 Laptop SM89, batch=1 decode, BF16 weights and activations, natural prompts

incumbent.candidate: SM89-specialized M=1 BF16 lm_head GEMV inside vLLM

optimistic_weight_stream_bound.qualification: This deliberately ignores mandatory compute, recurrent state, attention, synchronization and sampling. It rules out a strict-BF16 2x claim but is not an achievable latency prediction.

backbone_projection_residual.qualification: The raw gap is an upper bound before accounting for mandatory arithmetic and is not wholly removable.

screened_portfolio.result: 1.0165x TPOT and 2/6 exact in the reachable full variant
projected 0.9849x versus non-speculative at measured acceptance; still needs 0.6182 ms independent cycle saving to clear 1.03x

frontiers.strict_token_exact: The lm_head-only candidate is the best measured member of the bounded candidate portfolio.
frontiers.limited_task_quality: The lm_head plus segmented-GDN candidate remains a separate BF16 numerical frontier after a 512-example GSM8K screen found no detectable paired accuracy regression.
frontiers.global_optimum: NOT_PROVEN. Persistent cross-layer scheduling, state-layout redesign, broader batching and architecture changes remain outside this certificate.

decision: Retain the lm_head-only strict winner. Do not spend additional budget on lm_head launch tuning or MTP projection-only wiring; reopen search only for a mechanism with an independent whole-step saving above the recorded decision boundary.
